title: Building Normalizing Flows with Stochastic Interpolants
tldr_zh: 随机插值定义任意两分布间路径，速度场为二次目标唯一极小点；对插值 max-min 可达 Benamou-Brenier OT
tldr_en: Stochastic interpolants define a density path between any two distributions; its velocity minimizes a quadratic loss, and maximizing over interpolants recovers Benamou-Brenier OT.
